texts.preamble: Ashok Dharmanaryan Joshi vs The State Of Maharashtra on 1 March, 2019 Author: Nitin W. Sambre Bench: Nitin W. Sambre 1 924) aba190-19.doc Sas In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction Anticipatory Bail Application No.190 Of 2019 Ashok Dharmanarayan Joshi ..Applicant. Coram : Nitin W. Sambre, J. Date : March 1, 2019 It is informed by learned counsel for the applicant, on instructions from the applicant, that Criminal Writ Petition No.676 of 2019 for quashing of F.I.R. No.848/2018 for offence punishable under sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(ii), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 registered with Faujdar Chawadi police station, Solapur is already lodged.
